topic: get rid of fungus gnats in houseplant soil
core_question: How do I get rid of little flying gnats in my houseplant soil? (secondary: How do you restore a couch's sagging cushions so they look and feel full again?)
answer_summary: Allow the top inch or two of soil to dry out fully between waterings to kill larvae, and set yellow sticky traps to catch adult gnats.; after the topic shift: Open the cushion covers and add a new high-density foam insert (or extra fiberfill/batting wrap) to restore loft and firmness.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; texting quickly with typos here and there
